entries.clue: Curved run of wedge-shaped stones that carries a road over a gap
Elephantine creature two friends set a Very Deep Pit for, and never caught
Grey donkey of the Wood who mislays his tail and expects the worst
Deep-pocketed grid of a cake, pressed golden in a hinged iron
Robbed from the comb of a hive, golden and slow to leave the spoon
Strawberries and sugar boiled down, set with pectin and sealed in a jar
Pouched mother of the Wood, who carries a small joey in her pocket
Deliberate gap in a deck that lets hot metal expand without buckling
Gusty and squally, as on the day that tipped Owl's house out of its tree
Rigid framework of triangles stiffening a railway deck
Steamy-windowed eating place where you order at the counter and sit down
Tilt a jug and let the stream fall steadily into a waiting glass
Drop this wedge in at the very top and every other block locks tight
